meta.title: Agent Channels
meta.description: Bring thirteen agent account channels — CodeArts, CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder, TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon, MiniMax Code, ZCode and Gemini — into DeepSeek Harness. Sign in once and their models appear in the composer's model picker. Credentials go to the local credential store only.
